faqs.q: Do you pay for old computers, servers and IT scrap?
faqs.a: Yes. Working IT equipment and high-value scrap such as servers, laptops, networking gear, copper cables and PCBs have resale or material value. We inspect the lot (photos are enough to start) and share a fair buyback quote. Low-value or non-working items are taken for compliant recycling.

faqs.q: What is the minimum quantity for a pickup?
faqs.a: We focus on business lots — offices, IT parks, factories and institutions. As a guide, we arrange free pickups for lots of roughly 50 kg or 10+ devices. Send us the details and we will confirm quickly.
All of Delhi-NCR: Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad and Ghaziabad. Pan-India bulk lots can be arranged on request.

faqs.q: Will I get a GST invoice and recycling documentation?
faqs.a: Yes. Every purchase is billed with a proper GST invoice. Material is routed to government-authorised recyclers and you receive the paperwork you need for your audit trail — including recycling / disposal certificates and, where applicable, data destruction certificates.

faqs.q: How is data on hard drives handled?
faqs.a: Data-bearing devices are handled under a chain-of-custody. Drives can be wiped, degaussed or physically destroyed — including on-site at your premises on request — and a certificate of data destruction is issued.

faqs.q: How fast can you pick up?
faqs.a: Most NCR requests get a call back within a few working hours and a pickup slot within 24–72 hours, depending on lot size and location.
